title: Faculty Info Professor of Education, Emeritus Degrees Ph.D., Harvard University, (1958)
bio: Home Faculty Directory Robert LeVine's research concerned cultural aspects of parenthood and child development in African, Asian, Latin American, and other societies. His most recent research was on the influence of maternal schooling on reproduction and child health care in Nepal. He examined how women's literacy positively affects their health and that of their children, as well as contributing to children's emerging literacy. Childcare and Culture: Lessons from Africa , (1994). Human Conditions: The Cultural Basis of Educational Development (with M. I. White), (1986). Culture, Behavior, and Personality , (1973).
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
